    Struct ViewModeCollectionConfigComponent

    Represents a component that provides configuration for a collection of view modes within an entity. Used to reference and manage the asset containing view mode settings.

    Syntax
    public struct ViewModeCollectionConfigComponent : IComponentData, IQueryTypeParameter, IViewModeCollectionConfigComponent
    Remarks

    Assign the configuration asset to the ConfigAsset field before accessing view mode data. This component is typically used in systems that require runtime access to view mode configurations for entities. Thread safety and asset lifecycle management should be considered when modifying the referenced asset.

    Fields

    Holds a reference to the configuration asset that defines available view modes.

    UnityObjectRef<ViewModeCollectionConfigAsset>
    Remarks

    Use this property to access or assign the asset containing view mode collection settings. The referenced asset must be of type ViewModeCollectionConfigAsset and should be assigned before accessing view mode data.
